get.summary: Liveness: the process is up. No dependencies checked.
Readiness: database reachable and schema exactly matches this build's migrations.

AlbumPatch.description: Absent fields are left unchanged; `null` clears; `credits`/`tracks`, when present, replace the list.

Alias.description: A verified alternate spelling or name. Always carries its source.

source.description: Required: where this alternate name is attested.

name.description: As written, in any script. Never translated.

isni.description: ISNI; spaces and hyphens allowed, check digit verified.

ArtistPatch.description: Absent fields are left unchanged; `null` clears an optional field.

expected_version.description: The `version` the client last read. Stale → `409 version_conflict`.

AuditEventPage.description: Cursor pagination envelope used by every list endpoint.

recordings.description: Newest 100 recordings; page through `GET /recordings?composition_id=` for all.

CompositionPatch.description: Absent fields are left unchanged; `null` clears; `credits`, when present, replaces the list.

source_contribution_id.description: Optional pointer to the original (or other version) this one was made from.

expected_parent_revision_id.description: The head revision that was reviewed. A mismatch returns 409 with `current_revision_id`.

current_revision_id.description: Send this as `expected_parent_revision_id` when editing or deciding. Author and moderators only.

has_unpublished_changes.description: The head differs from what is public. Author and moderators only.

oneOf.description: Newest revision, which may be unpublished. Author and moderators only.
The public revision: what everyone reads. Null until something is published.

ContributionSummary.description:
One lyric version in a slot (recording + type + language + script). Several contributions
may share a slot as alternatives; at most one is the primary.

dir.description: Text direction of the script; set it on the element that renders the body.

script.description: ISO 15924 script code (`Mlym`, `Arab`). Language and script are separate on purpose.

source_contribution_id.description: The translated or transliterated original, when it is public.

status.description: Review state of the newest revision. The public always sees `published`.

Credit.description: One artist in one role. Artist names are shown verbatim, never translated.

artist_name.description: Base (original) name; use `artist_display` for the localized one.

role_category.description: Original songwriters, translators and adapters are distinct categories; group by this.

role_id.description: Id of the credit role entity, which can be localized like any other.

CreditRole.description:
Composition: composer, lyricist. Recording: performer, featured_performer, arranger, producer,
conductor. Album: primary_artist, producer.

language.description: ISO 639-1/639-3 code of the language the entity was originally written in.

Display.description:
How to show an entity's name. When `fallback` is true the text is **not** in the requested
language and the UI must say so. Set `lang` and `dir` on the element that renders `text`.

language.description: Language of `text` (`ml`, `sr-Latn`); null for a base name of unknown language.

EntitySuggestion.description: One candidate. Store `id`, never the name.

code.description: ISO code for languages and scripts.

detail.description: Artist disambiguation, or a language's endonym.

matched_via.description: Which of the entity's names matched what was typed.

score.description: 1 = exact ignoring case/spacing/punctuation/diacritics, 0.9 = prefix, otherwise similarity.

default_script.description: ISO 15924 code of the usual script.

endonym.description: The language's own name for itself.

Localization.description: One name of an entity in one language (and optionally script). Personal names are never machine-made.

current_revision_id.description: Send as `expected_parent_revision_id` on the next write.

is_preferred.description:
Omitted: preferred iff it is the first name in that language. `true` when another preferred
name exists is `409 preferred_slot_taken`; names are never swapped silently.

source.description: Required for artist names (where the name comes from).

LocalizationPatch.description: Absent fields are left unchanged; `null` clears an optional field.

expected_parent_revision_id.description: The `current_revision_id` the client last read. Stale → `409 stale_revision` carrying the current one.

text.description: The name that matched, as written. May differ from `display` (an alias or another script).

entity_type.description: `artist`, `album`, `label`, `publisher` or `genre`. Languages and scripts are never merged.

expected_from_version.description: Both versions are required, so a merge is never decided on a stale view.

from_id.description: The duplicate; it disappears and its id redirects to `into_id`.

accepted.description: Suggestions the client reported as chosen (suggest only).

candidate_ids.description: Present on `409 likely_duplicates`: entities that probably are the one being proposed.

current_revision_id.description: Present on `409` revision conflicts: the revision the client must rebase onto.

current_version.description: Present on `409 version_conflict`: the record's current `version`; reload, then reapply.

existing_id.description: Present on `409 duplicate_identifier` when known: the record already holding the identifier.

duplicate_of_id.description: The existing entity a rejection pointed to.

entity_id.description: The canonical entity an approval created.

shown_matches.description: The likely matches the proposer was shown and set aside.

aliases.description: Other spellings; verified as aliases when the proposal is approved.

confirm_distinct.description: Set after looking at the `409 likely_duplicates` candidates and deciding this is a different entity.
Approve only: approve although likely duplicates exist.

duplicate_of_id.description: Reject only: the existing entity that should have been used.

composition_id.description: The existing composition this is a recording of (covers reuse the original's composition).

credits.description: Performance-level credits (performer, featured_performer, arranger, producer, conductor).

relationships.description: Links from this recording to others (e.g. this is a `cover` of `related_recording_id`).

related_from.description: Others → this recording (e.g. … is a `cover` of it).

relationships.description: This recording → others (e.g. it is a `cover` of …).

RecordingPatch.description: Absent fields are left unchanged; `null` clears; `credits`/`relationships`, when present, replace the list.

locale.description: UI locale for emails. One of `en`, `ar`. Defaults to `en`.

RelationshipKind.description: All kinds except `related_performance` require both recordings to share a composition.

restored_from_revision_id.description: Set when this revision restored an older one.

expected_parent_revision_id.description: The head revision you based this on. Required; a mismatch returns 409 with `current_revision_id`.

restore_from_revision_id.description: Restore an older revision of this contribution as a new revision.

RevisionSummary.description: A revision without its body, for history lists.

size.description: Length of the body in characters.

RoleCategory.description: Credit categories. Original songwriters, translators and adapters are always separate groups.

next_cursor.description: Pass with `type` to get the next page of this group.

groups.description: Always every requested group, in a fixed order; a group with no hits is empty.

auto_publish_min_published.description: Members with at least this many published contributions publish without review; null disables it.

auto_publish_roles.description: Role names (`moderator`, `admin`) whose submissions publish without review.
